en:
The template sensor entity with `{identifier}` sets options in `attributes` that have a dedicated option. Setting these options in `attributes` is deprecated and will stop working in a future version of Home Assistant.

Update your YAML configuration by moving the following options out of `attributes` to their dedicated option, or by removing them from `attributes` if the dedicated option is already set:

{options}

The `device_class` and `state_class` options do not support templates, use a supported device class and state class. A numeric device class or state class requires a numeric state. Set a matching `unit_of_measurement` where required by the selected class; unitless sensors do not need one. The `last_reset` option requires `state_class: total`, set that state class or remove `last_reset`.

After updating the configuration, reload the template entities or restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
